traitsToPreserve: Receiving/hearth/private household, account room, guarded coin cabinet and southern rider reserve have distinct purposes.
Double-opening counting screen, raised coursed masonry piers and reserve screen shape movement; unchanged fort benefits and two-post entry crossfire support defenders.
Silver coin stacks, sealed portrait-crown consignments, weighing/ledger counter, bordered warm rugs, stone courses and household furniture remain procedural at native 150%.
Crag’s horned humanoid body and six larger armored direwolf riders remain the seven original defenders; no stat/reward/roster change.
All 16 original prop IDs, three exact cache identities, paid/dead progress, seized crowns and pending/paired-return rules remain compatible.
